regeneration_reason: Updated in the same change as ISSUE-20260824-001 because a new server concurrency module is registered in the feature-route boundary, destructive route contracts now require projectId+version, and a multi-BrowserContext concurrency flow was added.

nodes.label: Web App Shell
nodes.role: Authentication, dashboard, projects and user-administration shell.

nodes.label: Project Workspace
nodes.role: Project tabs and composition of design, run, Excel/export and recycle-bin panels.

nodes.label: Test Design UI
nodes.role: Scenario editor and FolderExplorer orchestration. Destructive folder/scenario requests send the observed entity version.

nodes.label: Folder Explorer
nodes.role: Folder/scenario tree selection, context menus, rename, delete and drag/drop.

nodes.label: Run Workspace
nodes.role: Run execution, conflict UI and evidence/procedure compatibility UI. Run/evidence/procedure deletes send observed versions.

nodes.label: Recycle Bin UI
nodes.role: Loads deleted versioned entities and restores them with the version returned by the deleted-list response.

nodes.label: Browser API Client
nodes.role: Same-origin typed fetch wrapper for shell-level endpoints.

nodes.label: Fastify API Core
nodes.role: Authentication/admin routes, CSRF and request-scoped transaction hooks.

nodes.label: Feature Route Registration
nodes.role: Registers feature routes and the centralized destructive optimistic-lock guard.

nodes.label: Destructive Concurrency Guard
nodes.role: For versioned delete/restore endpoints, requires authentication and project edit permission, then row-locks the target and compares the client-observed version before the route mutation executes.
constraints: Runs inside the request-scoped MariaDB transaction started by app.ts.
Authenticates and authorizes project edit before target-row lookup.
Uses SELECT ... FOR UPDATE against a static table whitelist.
Requires body projectId and positive integer version.
Version/state mismatch returns HTTP 409 before delete/restore.

nodes.label: Test Case Routes
nodes.role: Test-case CRUD, steps/tags/folders, duplication, delete and restore.
constraints: PATCH is optimistic-locked by test_cases.version.
DELETE/restore are protected by destructive_concurrency_guard using the observed version.

nodes.label: Definition Routes
nodes.role: Folder, scenario and data-set CRUD and relationships.
constraints: PATCH operations compare entity version.
Folder/scenario/data-set DELETE and restore are row-locked and version-checked by destructive_concurrency_guard.

nodes.label: Scenario Editor Routes
nodes.role: Atomic scenario/case/common-data editor save and test-case view-image domain.
constraints: Existing scenario, case and common-data writes compare supplied versions and return 409 on stale state.
Composite save is transactional.

nodes.label: Run Domain Routes
nodes.role: Run snapshots, revisions, results, assignments, completion, delete and restore.
constraints: Run/run-case/run-scenario PATCH operations use optimistic locking.
Run DELETE/restore are row-locked and version-checked by destructive_concurrency_guard.

nodes.label: Evidence and Procedure Routes
nodes.role: Evidence upload/download/versioning/delete/restore and retained procedure CRUD.
constraints: Evidence image version creation guards current_version.
Evidence/procedure DELETE and restore are row-locked and version-checked by destructive_concurrency_guard.

nodes.label: Excel Import Routes
nodes.role: Official template, preview and one-time confirm/import.
constraints: Import confirm atomically claims confirmed_at IS NULL to prevent double confirmation.

nodes.label: MariaDB Persistence
nodes.role: MariaDB pool and AsyncLocalStorage request transaction boundary.
constraints: Each concurrent HTTP write uses its request-local transaction connection.
The destructive guard holds a target-row lock until the request transaction commits or rolls back.
Concurrent stale run-case writes are integration-tested as one 200 and one 409.

nodes.label: User Session Store
nodes.role: Cookie token hashing, user_sessions lookup/creation and session invalidation semantics.
constraints: Each successful login creates a new independent user_sessions row.
Logout removes only the current session; password change removes other sessions; admin reset removes all target-user sessions.

nodes.label: Web API Contract
nodes.role: Canonical HTTP contract. Versioned destructive mutations require projectId and the client-observed version and document 409 conflict responses.

flows.label: Concurrent browser sessions
constraints: The regression test uses two sessions for the same administrator and one independently authenticated assigned executor.
Same-user stale writes produce one success and one 409; different users may concurrently update independent rows; logging out one same-user session leaves the others valid.

flows.label: Delete and restore lifecycle
constraints: Deleted-list responses expose entity versions and RecycleBinPanel sends the observed version on restore.
A stale delete or restore receives HTTP 409 without mutating the row.
